title.zh: 将南甘马粦省卡拉莫安半岛公路命名为省长Felix A. Fuentebella国家公路的法案
title.en: An Act Renaming the Caramoan Peninsula Road in the Province of Camarines Sur to Governor Felix A. Fuentebella National Highway
title.orig: An Act Renaming the Caramoan Peninsula Road in the Province of Camarines Sur to Governor Felix A. Fuentebella National Highway
title.vi: Đạo luật đổi tên Đường Caramoan Peninsula tại Tỉnh Camarines Sur thành Quốc lộ Governor Felix A. Fuentebella Quốc gia
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนชื่อถนน Caramoan Peninsula ในจังหวัด Camarines Sur เป็นทางหลวง Governor Felix A. Fuentebella แห่งชาติ
title.id: Undang-Undang Mengubah Nama Jalan Caramoan Peninsula di Provinsi Camarines Sur menjadi Jalan Raya Governor Felix A. Fuentebella Nasional
title.ms: Akta Menukar Nama Jalan Caramoan Peninsula di Wilayah Camarines Sur kepada Lebuh Raya Governor Felix A. Fuentebella Kebangsaan

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra2000/ra_8968_2000.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The Caramoan Peninsula road, a national road connecting and comprising the municipalities of Lagonoy, Presentacion, Garchitorena and Caramoan, all in the Province of Camarines Sur and bounded by the following road sections, to wit: (a) the 31.73 km. Lagonoy - Presentacion road; (b) the 18.65 km. Presentacion - Maligaya road; (c) the 31.748 km. Maligaya Junction - Caramoan - Guijalo road; and (d) the 12.075 km. Maligaya - Garchitorena road, is hereby renamed as the Governor Felix A. Fuentebella National Highway.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
